name: mochicode-auto
description: Preserve the selected authority for normal work, add justified bounded workers or evidence gates, and use Manager Mode only for an explicit Manager Mode implementation request.

interface.longDescription: Preserves the current selected authority for normal work, uses Luna only for sizable independent leaves, and activates bounded Manager Mode only for an explicit Manager Mode implementation request. Automatic classification stays shadow-only. The current selected authority manager advances one receipt-backed phase at a time while deterministic state rotates failures, parks repeats, supports stop and resume, and permits one replan. Fresh verification remains risk-triggered, and the heavier controller remains experimental.
defaultPrompt: Complete this goal using the smallest quality-proven automatic route.
Preserve the current selected authority and effort unless a proven worker route clearly repays its overhead.
Use Manager Mode only when explicitly requested; otherwise keep the selected parent and add only justified support.
